safe_area.reason: Trim and bleed variance plus the grip margin on a hand-held sheet mean the outer band cannot carry anything that must not be cut or covered. The lower margin is a little deeper where a folded or bound edge is possible.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One clear entry point, then a readable path through the supporting information. The sheet is held and read at arm's length, so it can carry more than a feed asset but still needs a single place for the eye to land first.
